name: showreel-c3-white-pyramid

voice.text: Why did the Great Pyramid stop shining white? 4,500 years ago, it was cased in polished white limestone. The blocks came from quarries across the Nile. About 900 years ago, builders took the stones for Cairo. What you see today is the rough, stepped core underneath. A few casing stones still sit at its foot. Next door, Khafre's pyramid still has its casing at the top. Turns out, it never faded; it was stripped for stone.

caption:
The Great Pyramid didn't fade from white to brown. It was cased in smooth white limestone, and the stones were carried off to build Cairo. 🏜️
